description: This is a PHP unit test class for the LanguageAPI in the OrangeHRM system. It includes setup, data providers, and test methods for CRUD operations on Language entities within the Admin API.

classes.name: LanguageAPITest
classes.description: Unit test class for the LanguageAPI class, testing getAll, getOne, create, update, and delete operations with mock services.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Prepares the test environment by truncating language tables and populating fixtures from a YAML file.

methods.name: testGetAll
methods.description: Tests retrieving all language entries via the LanguageAPI.

methods.name: dataProviderForTestGetAll
methods.description: Provides test cases for the getAll test method from a YAML data file.

methods.name: testGetOne
methods.description: Tests retrieving a single language entry via the LanguageAPI.

methods.name: dataProviderForTestGetOne
methods.description: Provides test cases for getOne operation from a YAML data file.

methods.name: testCreate
methods.description: Tests creating a new language entry via the LanguageAPI.

methods.name: dataProviderForTestCreate
methods.description: Provides test cases for create operation from a YAML data file.

methods.name: testUpdate
methods.description: Tests updating an existing language entry via the LanguageAPI.

methods.name: dataProviderForTestUpdate
methods.description: Provides test cases for update operation from a YAML data file.

methods.name: testDelete
methods.description: Tests deleting a language entry via the LanguageAPI.

methods.name: dataProviderForTestDelete
methods.description: Provides test cases for delete operation from a YAML data file.
